tex_content.html: \begin{notation} \end{notation}[Lorentzian cosine] \group trigonometrySource: thurston:page-0027 Write $X\cdot Y=\sum _{i=1}^nX_iY_i-X_{n+1}Y_{n+1}$ and $c(X,Y)=(X\cdot Y)/(\sqrt{X\cdot X}\sqrt{Y\cdot Y})$ for non-null vectors. A real-length vector $Y$ represents the oriented hyperplane $Y^\perp $. \end{notation}
